result.brief: 提出 SPOT：用小型模型预测扩散语言模型的提交顺序，构建候选树并由目标模型单次验证，实现无损加速解码。
result.reason: Diffusion language model decoding acceleration via learned commit-order prediction; touches continuous/discrete latent diffusion LM inference, a secondary continuous-language interest with concrete transferable verification insight.
